 Daniele Doveri, born on December 10, 1977 in Volterra, Italy, is an Italian football referee affiliated with the Lega Nazionale Professionisti. Throughout his career, he has refereed a total of 319 matches, in which he has shown 1,244 yellow cards and 30 red cards, averaging 3.90 yellow cards per game. Doveri is known for his strict but fair refereeing style, applying the rules with precision and maintaining control of the game without interfering excessively.
